requests.change:
append the following recipes:

# Public static landing (site/): frozen-lockfile install. No server and no deployment.
site-install:
    cd site && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

# Type check of the public landing; zero svelte-check errors and warnings are expected.
site-check:
    cd site && pnpm run check

# Offline frozen install, type check and prerendered build of the public landing into site/build.
site-build:
    cd site && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline && pnpm run check && pnpm run build

# Leak scan of the built landing, its sources and the vendored carriers. Run site-build first.
site-leak-scan:
    cd site && node scripts/leak-scan.mjs build && node scripts/leak-scan.mjs . --surface source && node scripts/leak-scan.mjs vendor --surface vendor

# Public landing lane tests (pins, prerender config, content contract, leak rules, fresh build checks).
site-test:
    PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_public_site_s3 -v

# OUTWARD-FACING: publishes site/build to Cloudflare Pages. Refuses unless the operator sets
# VIDEO_UTILS_SITE_DEPLOY_OPERATOR_GO=deploy-public-site for this one invocation (site/DEPLOY.md).
# Credentials come only from the operator's environment; none is stored in this repository.
site-pages-deploy project branch:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    if [ "${VIDEO_UTILS_SITE_DEPLOY_OPERATOR_GO:-}" != "deploy-public-site" ]; then
        echo "site-pages-deploy: refused. Deploying the public site needs a separate operator go; see site/DEPLOY.md." >&2
        exit 64
    fi
    if ! command -v wrangler >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "site-pages-deploy: wrangler is not on PATH; the operator pins and provides it (site/DEPLOY.md)." >&2
        exit 69
    fi
    just site-build
    just site-leak-scan
    just site-test
    cd site && wrangler pages deploy build --project-name {{quote(project)}} --branch {{quote(branch)}}
requests.why: operator entrypoints for the public landing (contract section 9). site-pages-deploy is the only outward-facing recipe and refuses unless the operator sets VIDEO_UTILS_SITE_DEPLOY_OPERATOR_GO=deploy-public-site for that invocation.
requests.evidence: The exact text was loaded from a scratch justfile: `just --list` parsed all six recipes; site-leak-scan ran against the worktree and exited 0; site-pages-deploy without the variable refused with exit 64 before reaching wrangler. The deploy branch past the refusal was not executed.
